Profile

The person
behind the process.

From Visakhapatnam to Limerick | building a career at the intersection of quality science, regulatory precision, and medical innovation.

Three years at Syneos Health, a top-five global CRO, managing quality system records and controlled documentation across Phase I–IV international studies for sponsors including Alexion, an AstraZeneca Rare Disease company, Daiichi Sankyo, Mapkure, and Tsumura. Across FDA, EMA, and Health Canada audit cycles: zero critical findings.

Master of Science in Process Validation and Regulatory Affairs with Medical Technology from TUS Limerick, completed First Class Honours. Dissertation on risk-based CSA and GAMP 5 frameworks for Class III medical devices. Currently supporting equipment validation at University Hospital Limerick.

Six Sigma Black Belt. GCP certified. TUS Global Ambassador. Founder of Ireland with Kishore, a platform supporting international students across Ireland.
